g.text: • German Noun Capitalization: Left Thumb 15 (Space) → Right Thumb 16 (Sticky Shift) → Noun Letter
(Shift automatically arms for exactly 1 letter and disarms immediately after — no holding required)
• Double Letters (Schifffahrt, Bitte, Alles): Type letter → Right Thumb 16 (Instant Repeat)
(Outputs repeated character instantly with zero finger movement or layer delay)
• German Eszett (Straße, groß, weiß): Pinch Left Home Keys 6 + 7 (S + R) on base
(Outputs native ß instantly without switching to special symbol layers)
• Continuous Secondary Alphas (BMW, Quiz): Hold Left Thumb 14 (a2 Dual) → Type letters
